note: STISS manifests with variable craniofacial dysmorphisms and developmental delay, making mid- and lower-facial feature specificity plausible but unproven against overlapping cohorts.

evidence.text: STISS exhibits highly variable expressivity of clinical features, including developmental delay/intellectual disability, craniofacial dysmorphisms, and preaxial limb defects.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: The expressivity of most clinical features in STISS is highly variable.

evidence.text: Individuals with truncating PSMD12 variants consistently presented with craniofacial and skeletal anomalies alongside developmental delay, showing marked phenotypic variability.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating PSMD12 Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: all individuals presented with developmental delay, intellectual disability, craniofacial, and skeletal anomalies.
